headline: Philippine Women's Kata Team Wins Historic Asian Games Bronze
seoTitle: PH Women's Karate Kata Team Wins 2026 Asian Games Bronze | FMB News
seoDescription: Rebecca Torres, Samantha Veguillas and Ysabielle Arrogante beat Thailand 4-1 to win bronze in the women's team kata event at the 2026 Asian Games.
deck: Rebecca Torres, Samantha Veguillas and Ysabielle Arrogante defeated Thailand 4-1 in the bronze-medal match, delivering the Philippines' first Asian Games medal in women's team kata.
author: FMB News Sports Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Philippine women's karate kata team of Rebecca Torres, Samantha Veguillas and Ysabielle Arrogante won bronze at the 2026 Asian Games on Tuesday after defeating Thailand 4-1 in the medal bout at Toyohashi Gymnasium.

sections.heading: What is confirmed
paragraphs: Philippine News Agency and GMA News independently report the 4-1 bronze-medal victory over Thailand and identify Torres, Veguillas and Arrogante as the Philippine trio. The Philippine Star's on-site report independently corroborates the medal and describes it as the country's first Asian Games medal in the team kata event.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The Filipinas beat Cambodia 5-0 in the quarterfinals before losing 0-5 to Iran in the semifinals, sending them into the bronze-medal contest.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The bronze extends Philippine karate's medal streak to three consecutive Asian Games and marks a first podium finish for the Philippines in the women's team kata event. It adds another medal to Team Philippines' early Aichi-Nagoya haul.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The Philippine karate campaign continues in other kata and kumite events. This article records the women's team kata result as completed; no higher medal remains pending for this event.
